mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_audit_log (trace_id, module, action, resource_type, resource_id, actor, actor_id, actor_dept_id, actor_dept, client_ip, request_uri, before_value, after_value, diff_value, status, error_message, comment, cost_ms, created_at) VALUES (#{traceId}, #{module}, #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{actor}, #{actorId}, #{actorDeptId}, #{actorDept}, #{clientIp}, #{requestUri}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{diff}, COALESCE(#{status}, 0), #{errorMessage}, #{comment}, #{costMs}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_audit_log WHERE created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_audit_log WHERE created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
